description: Create a structured feature specification with self-contained task files organized into parallel execution batches. Use this skill when the user says "create a spec", "plan this feature", "write up an implementation plan", "break this into tasks", or after any planning conversation where the user wants to capture decisions as actionable spec files. Also use when the user says "/spec-create" (or their host's equivalent invocation syntax) or wants to decompose a feature into work items that agents can implement independently. This skill produces local spec files under specs/{feature}/ — no GitHub integration.
